reason: SLM-SQL applies SFT/RL to small task-specific models and corrective self-consistency inference. On BIRD, increasing samples 16→64 raises time 0.83→2.68 hours and cost/question $0.00014→$0.00046 for its 1.5B setting. Its primary contribution is task-specific Text-to-SQL post-training rather than an inference-efficiency improvement.
title: SLM-SQL: An Exploration of Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL
